{
 "cells": [
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Prediction (out of sample)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-21T14:03:26.096525Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-21T14:03:26.096319Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-21T14:03:27.658083Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-21T14:03:27.657381Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "%matplotlib inline"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-21T14:03:27.666225Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-21T14:03:27.665919Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-21T14:03:31.480064Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-21T14:03:31.479404Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "\n",
    "import statsmodels.api as sm\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.rc(\"figure\", figsize=(16, 8))\n",
    "plt.rc(\"font\", size=14)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Artificial data"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-21T14:03:31.489184Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-21T14:03:31.488678Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-21T14:03:31.497818Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-21T14:03:31.497253Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "nsample = 50\n",
    "sig = 0.25\n",
    "x1 = np.linspace(0, 20, nsample)\n",
    "X = np.column_stack((x1, np.sin(x1), (x1 - 5) ** 2))\n",
    "X = sm.add_constant(X)\n",
    "beta = [5.0, 0.5, 0.5, -0.02]\n",
    "y_true = np.dot(X, beta)\n",
    "y = y_true + sig * np.random.normal(size=nsample)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Estimation "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-21T14:03:31.501026Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-21T14:03:31.500677Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-21T14:03:31.528257Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-21T14:03:31.527760Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "                            OLS Regression Results                            \n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "Dep. Variable:                      y   R-squared:                       0.985\n",
      "Model:                            OLS   Adj. R-squared:                  0.984\n",
      "Method:                 Least Squares   F-statistic:                     1011.\n",
      "Date:                Sat, 21 Nov 2026   Prob (F-statistic):           5.55e-42\n",
      "Time:                        14:03:31   Log-Likelihood:                 2.4934\n",
      "No. Observations:                  50   AIC:                             3.013\n",
      "Df Residuals:                      46   BIC:                             10.66\n",
      "Df Model:                           3                                         \n",
      "Covariance Type:            nonrobust                                         \n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "                 coef    std err          t      P>|t|      [0.025      0.975]\n",
      "------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
      "const          4.8878      0.082     59.751      0.000       4.723       5.052\n",
      "x1             0.5088      0.013     40.327      0.000       0.483       0.534\n",
      "x2             0.5114      0.050     10.312      0.000       0.412       0.611\n",
      "x3            -0.0205      0.001    -18.505      0.000      -0.023      -0.018\n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "Omnibus:                        2.660   Durbin-Watson:                   2.431\n",
      "Prob(Omnibus):                  0.264   Jarque-Bera (JB):                1.482\n",
      "Skew:                           0.052   Prob(JB):                        0.477\n",
      "Kurtosis:                       2.163   Cond. No.                         221.\n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "\n",
      "Notes:\n",
      "[1] Standard Errors assume that the covariance matrix of the errors is correctly specified.\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "olsmod = sm.OLS(y, X)\n",
    "olsres = olsmod.fit()\n",
    "print(olsres.summary())"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## In-sample prediction"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-21T14:03:31.530895Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-21T14:03:31.530649Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-21T14:03:31.541416Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-21T14:03:31.538965Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[ 4.37530546  4.86620904  5.31693115  5.69959973  5.99640162  6.20250918\n",
      "  6.32687346  6.39075359  6.42422392  6.46123295  6.53402563  6.66784564\n",
      "  6.87678792  7.1614829   7.50899293  7.89493792  8.28750086  8.65265533\n",
      "  8.95975591  9.18657315  9.32294579  9.37245024  9.35181298  9.28816244\n",
      "  9.21457191  9.16462564  9.16690107  9.24027365  9.39081564  9.61079844\n",
      "  9.87996243 10.16884549 10.44362363 10.67166809 10.82690623 10.89410514\n",
      " 10.87137438 10.77047657 10.61489484 10.4359746  10.26777358 10.14146627\n",
      " 10.08022198 10.09539824 10.18467479 10.33243475 10.51233047 10.69161234\n",
      " 10.83650951 10.91777829]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "ypred = olsres.predict(X)\n",
    "print(ypred)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Create a new sample of explanatory variables Xnew, predict and plot"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-21T14:03:31.545861Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-21T14:03:31.545642Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-21T14:03:31.558385Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-21T14:03:31.552382Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[10.90246235 10.75208039 10.48668844 10.15199167  9.80815415  9.5150686\n",
      "  9.31769257  9.23504125  9.25553189  9.33981966]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "x1n = np.linspace(20.5, 25, 10)\n",
    "Xnew = np.column_stack((x1n, np.sin(x1n), (x1n - 5) ** 2))\n",
    "Xnew = sm.add_constant(Xnew)\n",
    "ynewpred = olsres.predict(Xnew)  # predict out of sample\n",
    "print(ynewpred)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Plot comparison"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-21T14:03:31.561883Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-21T14:03:31.561662Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-21T14:03:32.055236Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-21T14:03:32.054553Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "<matplotlib.legend.Legend at 0x7c60aee53380>"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 7,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1600x800 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots()\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, y, \"o\", label=\"Data\")\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, y_true, \"b-\", label=\"True\")\n",
    "ax.plot(np.hstack((x1, x1n)), np.hstack((ypred, ynewpred)), \"r\", label=\"OLS prediction\")\n",
    "ax.legend(loc=\"best\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Predicting with Formulas"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Using formulas can make both estimation and prediction a lot easier"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-21T14:03:32.059383Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-21T14:03:32.059162Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-21T14:03:32.074991Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-21T14:03:32.073835Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "from statsmodels.formula.api import ols\n",
    "\n",
    "data = {\"x1\": x1, \"y\": y}\n",
    "\n",
    "res = ols(\"y ~ x1 + np.sin(x1) + I((x1-5)**2)\", data=data).fit()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "We use the `I` to indicate use of the Identity transform. Ie., we do not want any expansion magic from using `**2`"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-21T14:03:32.078838Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-21T14:03:32.078636Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-21T14:03:32.087104Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-21T14:03:32.086491Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "Intercept           4.887758\n",
       "x1                  0.508760\n",
       "np.sin(x1)          0.511422\n",
       "I((x1 - 5) ** 2)   -0.020498\n",
       "dtype: float64"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 9,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "res.params"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Now we only have to pass the single variable and we get the transformed right-hand side variables automatically"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-21T14:03:32.090940Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-21T14:03:32.090747Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-21T14:03:32.101844Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-21T14:03:32.101375Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "0    10.902462\n",
       "1    10.752080\n",
       "2    10.486688\n",
       "3    10.151992\n",
       "4     9.808154\n",
       "5     9.515069\n",
       "6     9.317693\n",
       "7     9.235041\n",
       "8     9.255532\n",
       "9     9.339820\n",
       "dtype: float64"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 10,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "res.predict(exog=dict(x1=x1n))"
   ]
  }
 ],
